<!-- This repo uses spec-anchored development: design is reviewed in a spec-only PR before any implementation PR.
     Write Description and Complexity yourself, without AI: writing them checks that you own the change and challenges the design before review. -->

## PR type
Select one:
- [ ] **spec-only** - adds or modifies a change spec in `openspec/changes/`, no implementation.
- [ ] **implementation of `openspec/changes/<change-id>/`** - The spec might also have changed as a result of implementation evidence.
- [ ] **trivial** - fixes and changes that modify neither the spec nor observed behavior.

## Description
<!-- What this change does and why. -->

## Complexity
<!-- Where this PR introduces the most complexity and which requirement makes it necessary. -->
